tips.text: Run the Void Storms solo or with a coordinated duo; public squads leave breaches unfixed.
For mastery alone any roll works; Valence Fusion can raise the bonus later.
Skip chasing 60% unless you want the Ferrox for real use; it can take many copies and gives no mastery.
Players dislike the Holokey farm for hiding non-Railjack gear behind Railjack, but recent reports call it milder.
